newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada again sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a second round of special purchase and resale agreements at 3.25 percent in the money market, traders said.
Dealers said the central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate was bid at 3.25 percent, the top of the Bank of Canada's 2.75-3.25 percent target range.

"There just dislocations I believe in cash. The Bank is just addressing the fact that we're nudging up against the upper edge of his band so he's adding liquidity into the system to combat that," said a T-bill dealer with one bank-owned brokerage.
Traders said the intervention had no policy implications. The dealer said a third round of specials did not appear likely.
Canada's three month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 3.18 percent in the wake of the intervention.
